notes: Two asymmetric but repeatable job loops - heist, escape, launder against patrol, intercept, arrest - running in one persistent drivable city is Role Sim, so Simulation leads and Action is named second for the on-foot fights and arrests; this is not a Shooter, since the author rewards non-lethal arrest over kills and the map organises around districts and pursuit roads rather than firing corridors. world-open is what the author asked for outright, and their answer that interiors stay on the same map with seamless entrances so pursuits remain continuous is also what earns the P3: heist targets, faction bases and the prison complex are all entered, so the modifier is a stated feature rather than an assumption. Beyond the preset I added building-interior, settlement-density for the few-blocks-per-district grid, npc-population for the traffic, civilians and security guards, and water-body for the docks with boat and jet-ski access, which is what the CHECK is for - I expect it to clear, since the harbour is a surface feature rather than a swum volume. With no user to ask I read the four named districts as zones of one continuous compact map rather than separate maps, which matches the 16-player server and the request that players cross the city quickly, and I let building-interior carry the precinct, safehouse and prison since nothing in the tables covers a faction facility on its own.
